annotation.bound_parties_text: Road testing and demonstration application entities (subjects) must submit applications for safety assessment, and public security traffic management authorities issue temporary plates after the assessment report is formed.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 道路测试、示范应用主体应当向北京经济技术开发区管委会（具体由市智慧城市基础设施与智能网联汽车协同发展工作办公室负责组织实施）提交申请材料
annotation.dates_quote: 本办法自印发之日起实施。
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 北京市自动驾驶汽车安全评估办法（试行）
